summary: Verified UI for 3 Hospitality features on /ospitalita (ev_qa_1 'Maratona QA'): (1) OccupantiSelect with popover search, staff list sorted Cognome->Nome excluding current person, multi-select chips, external nominativo chip + persistence after save/reopen. (2) CopyServicesDialog with what-both/ospitalita/pasti toggle, target multi-select, correct 'Stai per copiare questi servizi su X persone' text, successful copy, target receives servizio_ospitalita but NO occupanti copied (verified empty chips on target lodging). (3) RoomsSummary block with 5 cards (totali/singole/doppie/triple/altre) in dashboard + 'Camere per struttura' block (rooms-by-structure) in view-struttura. Label 'Occupanti della camera' confirmed (old 'Compagno/i di camera' absent). All test data cleaned up (lodgings deleted, servizio reset to 'da_definire').
critical_code_review_comments: FIXED by testing agent: Hospitality.jsx was missing import for Popover/PopoverTrigger/PopoverContent, causing a runtime error ('Popover is not defined') as soon as the lodging edit form rendered OccupantiSelect. Added import from '@/components/ui/popover'. Without this fix the entire feature was blocked. Main agent should ensure similar imports are added when introducing new Radix primitives.

After copy with what='both' when source has only lodgings (no meals), target's servizio_ospitalita is set to 'solo_ospitalita' rather than 'ospitalita_pasti'. This looks reasonable (reflects what was actually copied) but spec is ambiguous; worth confirming expected semantics with product.

Minor: conflict dialog (copy-conflict) could not be exercised in this run because target persons had no pre-existing services. Backend logic for keep/replace was previously verified via curl per main agent's note.
seed_data_creation: Temporary: 3 lodgings created during flow (source + 2 copy targets). All removed; servizio_ospitalita reset to 'da_definire' for the 3 affected persons. Final state: 0 lodgings, 0 meals, rooms-summary all zero, 8 persone 'Senza sistemazione'.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Hospitality.jsx now correctly imports Popover. Key testids verified: rooms-summary + rooms-{camere-totali,singole,doppie,triple,altre}; rooms-by-structure (view-struttura tab); occupanti-select / occupanti-add / occupanti-popover / occupanti-search / occ-opt-<pid> / occ-chip-<i> / occupanti-ext-input / occupanti-ext-add; open-copy-services / copy-services-dialog / copy-what-{both,ospitalita,pasti} / copy-search / copy-person-<pid> / copy-summary-text / copy-confirm / copy-conflict / copy-keep / copy-replace. To exercise copy-conflict, pre-seed target persons with existing lodging/meal and set servizio to a non-'da_definire' value before clicking copy-confirm.
